page.overview:
Who is Liko?

Liko is one of the two protagonists of . She is a student of Indigo Academy. She is also one of the newest members of the Rising Volt Tacklers, the other being Roy.

Liko is a young girl with a light complexion. She has dark blue hair with blue highlights on the inside that is tied with a green clip, and has light blue eyes. She wears a light teal and yellow hexagonal shaped jewel pendant with a white sun-like symbol on the center. It has a three-point attachment at the bottom, resembling a component of the Tera Orb. She wears an aqua blue blazer coat over a white short sleeved shirt, dark blue shorts, long white shin-length socks with aqua blue trims, and white shoes with aqua-colored details.

She also wears the Indigo Academy school uniform consisting of a light brown short blazer and skirt, a white dress shirt, a red ribbon, long white socks, brown loafers and a badge with a leaf emblem. During the night, she wears the academy's tracksuit which has a leaf emblem on the front and back of the jacket.

As a young child, Liko's hair was shorter, and its bangs covered much of her forehead. She wore a blue and white striped dress that had a dark blue band around the waist, a white collar, and white cuffs. She also wore white socks, and a pair of red shoes with dull pink flowers and accents.
